description: Structured representation of InterSubMod/.claude/skills/known-pitfalls/SKILL.md (P-01..P-13). Used by /run-evaluator (P5 EVALUATE) to auto-sweep cycle artifacts. When known-pitfalls SKILL.md gains a new entry, append here too. Keep both in sync.
last_modified_reason: v1.8 T1-5: added P-08..P-13 from 2026-04 retract events + memory feedback (KDE stale / spatial autocorr / feature name literal / saturation artifact / merged AF drift / working tree dirty)

pitfalls.name: L2 Collider Bias
pitfalls.summary: Near-constant features (e.g. AlleleDelta in LOH regions) residualized on AF can produce spurious AUC jumps from 0.50 to 0.59.
pitfalls.correct_action: L2 residualized AUC must be cross-validated with L3 AF-bin stratification. If L2-vs-L3 gap > 0.10 → declare CONFOUND.
pitfalls.source_ref: O12 LOH 甲基化場景分析

auto_check_rule.if_keyword_match: L2 residualization OR residualize on AF

pitfalls.name: Pooled OLS Residualization Trap
pitfalls.summary: Pooled OLS (TP+FP combined) residuals retain group information because TP/FP occupy different feature-space regions; residual = between-group + within-group.
pitfalls.correct_action: Use within-group OLS (TP and FP fit separately). Memory: feedback_pooled_ols_residualization_trap.md.

pitfalls.name: VCF 來源錯誤歸因
pitfalls.summary: Mis-attributing canonical VCF to wrong pipeline (e.g. chenhan112 vs liaoyoyo2001 ClairS-TO with ONT_5kHz MM/ML BAM).
pitfalls.correct_action: Trace (1) who ran the caller, (2) which BAM, (3) MM/ML tag presence. Cross-check Knowledge/02_samples/ and Knowledge/03_file_formats/.
pitfalls.source_ref: 2026-04-14 TO pipeline staging v2 修正

auto_check_rule.if_keyword_match: canonical VCF OR VCF 來源

pitfalls.name: pileup Symlink 指向錯誤 Caller
pitfalls.summary: pileup-mode output symlink can point to ClairS paired (not TO), making TO analysis silently consume paired caller output.
pitfalls.correct_action: Use `readlink -f` on pileup symlinks before analysis. TO analysis requires ClairS-TO VCF; paired analysis requires ClairS paired VCF.

auto_check_rule.if_keyword_match: pileup symlink OR pileup mode TO

pitfalls.name: CramersV 93% Zero Artifact
pitfalls.summary: CramersV in 2×2 contingency tables only takes {0, 1} values; using it as a continuous feature is wrong (93% of regions are exactly 0).
pitfalls.correct_action: Replace CramersV with HPFineNGroups (AUC +0.125). Do not use CramersV as continuous discriminator.

pitfalls.name: n_reads / NumReads Confound
pitfalls.summary: Read count systematically inflates statistical power: more reads → tighter PERMANOVA p-value and larger HPFineNGroups; reflects detection power not biological effect.
pitfalls.correct_action: Control for n_reads (residualize or stratify). Any AUC > 0.58 must clear n_reads confound check.

pitfalls.name: single-track validated cycle (missing orthogonal evidence)
pitfalls.summary: Tier ⭐4/⭐5 cycle without orthogonal-track evidence (archive/replicate/alt-caller). 4-track L4 mandatory: (i) Statistical (ii) Cross-sample (iii) Mechanism (iv) Orthogonal — missing (iv) is the most common cause of retraction (e.g. 04-26 thread B whitelist).
pitfalls.correct_action: Before claiming ⭐4/⭐5, add 1 orthogonal-track artifact (archive comparison / replicate run / alternate caller) and reference it in plan.preconditions.upstream_reports. Otherwise downgrade to ⭐3 (described, single-track).
pitfalls.source_ref: plan v1.6 §4.5.4-G batch 5a anchor #1; validation-protocol L4 mandatory
pitfalls.added_by_anchor: anchor #1 L4 mandatory hardening (plan v1.6 §4.5.4-G batch 5a)

auto_check_rule.and_no_orthogonal_reference: len([r for r in plan.preconditions.upstream_reports if any(kw in r.lower() for kw in ['archive','replicate','alt-caller','orthogonal','cross-pipeline'])]) == 0

pitfalls.name: KDE-fix Stale Binary Downstream
pitfalls.summary: After a KDE/binary fix commit, downstream master_*.tsv.gz datasets may still be regenerated with the old binary version, leading to bias (e.g. HCC1395 S3 TP 95.5%→58.3% post-fix).
pitfalls.correct_action: Confirm dataset regeneration timestamp postdates binary fix commit. If precheck.checks.binary.stale_distance >= 1 → BLOCK and require dataset re-build with current binary.

pitfalls.name: Spatial Autocorrelation Confound (chr+pos aggregation)
pitfalls.summary: Features aggregated by chr+pos windows pick up spatial autocorrelation (linkage / hotspot density / replication timing) and produce inflated AUC that disappears after mid-TP-rate window stratification.
pitfalls.correct_action: Run mid-TP-rate window stratification; if AUC drops by >0.05 between unstratified and stratified → declare spatial autocorr confound and require within-window controls.

auto_check_rule.if_keyword_match: chr+pos OR spatial aggregation OR window-level feature

pitfalls.name: Feature Name Literal Interpretation
pitfalls.summary: Feature names suggesting biological semantics (e.g. HPFineNGroups → 'methylation subclone marker') often have implementation that does not match. Reading the C++ source is required before claiming biological interpretation. (HPFineNGroups 04-22 retract event)
pitfalls.correct_action: Before plan.hypothesis claims biological semantic, require plan.preconditions.source_code_refs containing src/include/ paths confirming feature definition matches claimed semantic.

auto_check_rule.if_keyword_match: HPFineNGroups OR methylation marker OR biology-informed

pitfalls.name: Saturation Artifact (single sample drives all)
pitfalls.summary: Cross-sample n_passed=1/N where the 1 sample is at saturation (e.g. H2009 飽和 in thread-B 04-26 retract event); the remaining N-1 samples all fail. Mean / pooled aggregation hides this.
pitfalls.correct_action: If generalize.consistency.n_samples_passed / n_samples_total <= 0.2 (i.e. only 1-2 of 6-7 samples) → BLOCK regardless of pooled metric. Investigate which sample drove the signal.

pitfalls.name: Merged Dataset AF Schema Drift
pitfalls.summary: merged_*.tsv.gz dataset may have an `AF` column whose values do not equal caller_af (5/7 samples in archive: p75 < 0.06). Always verify via plan.preconditions.dataset_id schema check + caller_af cross-reference.
pitfalls.correct_action: Replace `AF` column reads with caller_af joined from canonical/. If merged dataset is required, validate AF.p75 > 0.10 before downstream use.

auto_check_rule.if_keyword_match: merged dataset OR merged_phase1 OR phase1_new

pitfalls.name: Working Tree Dirty / Uncommitted Binary
pitfalls.summary: Pipeline ran with uncommitted local changes: results not reproducible; effect size also typically near-noise (e.g. longphase 04-29 ΔF1=-0.0003).
pitfalls.correct_action: BLOCK cycle until git working tree is clean OR plan.preconditions.binary_version is explicit SHA + diff snapshot is archived.
